notes.title: Demo Patch #3
notes.content:
## Bug Fixes
* Fixed window interaction range
* Improved Object dither-out distance
* Improved Ratio calculation for Chalk mini-game

## Changes
* New Setting: Camera Lag Toggle
* New Setting: Fullscreen Toggle
* Revamped sound effects: Puzzle Jingle, Gem Slotting
* Changed Hunting Tapestry to make cavehounds stand out more
* Changed history book texture to label the canyon and river
* Changed difficulty of chalk minigame

notes.title: Demo Patch #1
notes.content:
## Bug Fixes
* Fixed controller input breaking on battle puzzle when exiting "Restart Confirmation"
* Fixed repeating line about not know battle terms after getting note hint
* Fixed wrong objective displaying after portrait puzzle
* Fixed Gina showing up incorrectly in final cutscene
* Fixed begin able to give the Lunch Token too early

## Changes
* Added "Hint" option to Battle Puzzle
* Changed Sewing Puzzle Textures for User Experience improvements
